WITH delivered AS (
    SELECT cliente_id,
           pedido_id,
           fecha_entrega
    FROM   pedidos
    WHERE  estado = 'entregado'
           AND fecha_entrega IS NOT NULL
),
first AS (
    SELECT cliente_id,
           MIN(fecha_entrega) AS first_date
    FROM   delivered
    GROUP BY cliente_id
    HAVING MIN(fecha_entrega) BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-01-31'
),
subsequent AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.cliente_id
    FROM   delivered d
           JOIN first f ON d.cliente_id = f.cliente_id
    WHERE  d.fecha_entrega > f.first_date
           AND d.fecha_entrega <= date(f.first_date, '+90 day')
)
SELECT ROUND(
           CASE 
               WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM first) = 0 THEN 0
               ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subsequent) * 1.0
                    / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM first)
           END,
           4
       ) AS tasa;
